clinician.trajectory_summary: A 15-year-old female with intellectual disability, seizure history, and wart-like facial lesions since age 7 presented with dental caries and tooth pain. Neurologic examination was intact. Brain MRI and CT revealed several cortical and subcortical tubers and subependymal glial nodules without giant cell astrocytomas or aneurysm (E004). Panoramic dental imaging showed hypoplastic enamel and poor hygiene requiring endodontic treatments (E005). Dermatologic biopsy of facial lesions was ordered but not documented. The imaging and clinical features support the diagnosis of cortical and subcortical glioneuronal tubers and subependymal nodules consistent with tuberous sclerosis.
